description: Use when the user explicitly asks for an AINSOF editorial playlist by its exact name or key, such as Noir After Midnight or Sports. Return the website's matching tracks in order. For a genre or mood tag use browse_tag; for a creative brief use search_music. Continue with the same name or key, page size and cursor.

page_size.description: Number of primary tracks per page; separately displayed versions may add rows.

playlist_key.description: Exact editorial playlist name or key.

name: browse_playlist
